snippet.title: Detective Turner Announce Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
As part of Fellow Traveller’s Story Rich Showcase, we’re excited to announce Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill — the debut title from Johannesburg-based indie studio ALL DAY ALL NIGHT.

A text-driven murder mystery set in the cutthroat world of high fashion, the game casts players as an old-school detective investigating the death of a powerful magazine editor — Knives Out meets The Devil Wears Prada. 

Set to release on Steam in 2027, If Looks Could Kill features a striking, high-contrast graphic novel-inspired visual style and a distinctive text-first approach to investigation: Players uncover the truth by discovering hidden clues within the narrative that is written across floors, walls, and evidence.

Wishlist Detective Turner now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4544660/Detective_Turner_If_Looks_Could_Kill/
